title: The Shortest War in History

scenes.narration: This war was over faster than your lunch break.

icons.ai: a cartoon stopwatch with a nervous face and little arms
icons.name: stopwatch

scenes.narration: Look at this tiny island off the coast of East Africa. That's Zanzibar.
In 1896 it had its own sultan. But Britain wanted a say in who got the job.
scenes.tts: In eighteen ninety-six it had its own sultan. But Britain wanted a say in who got the job.

icons.ai: a sultan in white robes and a white turban sitting on a small golden throne
icons.name: crown

icons.ai: a victorian british naval officer in a dark blue uniform and bicorne hat holding a telescope
icons.name: man police officer

scenes.narration: Then the sultan died, and a rival named Khalid grabbed the throne without asking Britain first.

icons.ai: a cheeky young man in a turban and robes running while holding a golden crown
icons.name: person running

scenes.narration: Britain was not amused. Warships showed up, with a deadline: leave the palace by nine a.m.
scenes.tts: Britain was not amused. Warships showed up, with a deadline: leave the palace by nine A M.

icons.ai: a small grey victorian steam warship with a british flag, side view
icons.name: ship

scenes.narration: Khalid locked himself inside with around two thousand eight hundred defenders.

icons.ai: a small arabian palace with white walls and a red flag on top
icons.name: classical building

icons.ai: an arab palace guard in robes holding an old rifle
icons.name: guard

scenes.narration: Nine o'clock came. Nobody left. At two minutes past nine, the ships opened fire.

icons.ai: a small grey victorian steam warship firing its cannon with a puff of smoke, side view
icons.name: ship

scenes.narration: The palace caught fire. The sultan's only warship, a royal yacht, was sunk.

icons.ai: a small white royal steam yacht sinking with bubbles
icons.name: sailboat

scenes.narration: At nine forty, the flag came down. The whole war lasted about thirty-eight minutes.
Around five hundred people on the sultan's side were killed or wounded. On the British side, one sailor was hurt.
Khalid escaped through the German consulate. And his supporters were reportedly billed for the shells.

icons.ai: a young man in a turban and robes sneaking on tiptoe
icons.name: person running

scenes.narration: So what took longer today: this war, or your morning coffee?

post.title: The shortest war in history lasted 38 minutes ⏱️
post.description:
Ridiculous Wars #4 — In 1896 Britain and Zanzibar fought a war that was over in about 38 minutes.

Source: Anglo-Zanzibar War (27 August 1896)
